mechanism: Both agents increase risk of vitamin A toxicity through retinoid pathway activation; tazarotene is a retinoid and vitamin D metabolites can potentiate retinoid effects, increasing hypercalcemia and teratogenicity risk.
action: Monitor for signs of vitamin A toxicity (headache, bone pain, skin changes); ensure adequate contraception with tazarotene; consider vitamin D supplementation only if deficient and monitor calcium levels.
